caption: The drawing features four human-like figures labeled A through D, each with yellow bodies decorated with brown or red horizontal and vertical stripes. All the figures have large, round, white eyes with black outlines, and their mouths are marked with blue or black. The first figure on the left (A) wears a long red wrap garment with a white pattern, a necklace of white and blue beads, earrings of blue beads, and a prominent black-feathered headdress on its head. The second figure (B) has a similar yellow-striped body, a necklace, blue-beaded earrings, a circular ornament on one ear, and wears a red wrap with a black waistband and a plaid cloth draped on the side. The third figure (C) features a red waistband, a red wrap skirt, and a necklace and earrings made of blue beads. This figure has a more pronounced facial expression, with the mouth and eyes outlined. The fourth figure (D) is seated, with blue-beaded earrings, a white necklace, a red skirt, and a feather on the right side of the head. All figures are positioned upright except the last, which is in a seated pose. The background is plain and uncolored, causing the figures and their vibrant clothing and accessories to stand out clearly.
title: Indian Doll Group
